prose: Yogurt is presented by its developer as a free desktop meeting assistant that transcribes and summarizes calls locally rather than sending recordings to a hosted service. The launch post describes an MIT-licensed app that stays out of the meeting participant list and can optionally expose notes through a local MCP server. The source page was thin, so these details come from the developer's feed introduction rather than an independently tested installation.
highlights: Optional local MCP access to notes
basis: Developer launch post in the Hacker News feed; repository fetch was thin.
